metadata.title: That 1 lucky kill where Valorant said ‘Yeah, let’s confuse everyone’
metadata.description:
Clicked like a madman and somehow got the frag.
Enemy probably uninstalling to rethink their life choices.
Click if your aim’s a disaster but the game still throws freebies.
Watch me act like this was all planned!

Tap if your aim’s broken but luck’s got your back!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
